independence.label_source: observed baseline/candidate outputs against this directory's trusted synthetic assertions

order: unknown when either side has too few valid paired observations
harmful when the candidate fails an assertion the baseline passes, or its pass count is lower
beneficial when the candidate gains assertions and has no paired regression
unknown when paired assertion results disagree without strict net gain
unknown when a required claimed dimension such as performance lacks its frozen minimum measurements
neutral when all required observations exist and paired assertion outcomes are unchanged
